name: High Street engineering pilot
jurisdiction_context: Taguig, Metro Manila, Philippines; contextual label only

definition.author: Omni-BGC M1 governance lane
definition.method: Independently serialize the parent-selected rectangle from numeric bounds; no prior polygon, entity IDs, processed geometry or code imported.
definition.rationale: A small rectangular High Street work envelope supports reproducible pilot clipping, edge QA and bounded field collection. Bounds match the documented M0 audit pilot envelope for continuity of evidence, not as an assertion of district authority or real path coverage.

ingest_buffer.method: Transform scope polygon from EPSG:4326 to UTM zone 51N, buffer 200 metres, transform back to EPSG:4326 for extraction; preserve intersecting ways and relation members. Do not apply 200 as a degree offset.
ingest_buffer.purpose: Retain approach paths, crossings and outside connection candidates for later topology review; 200 m is an initial engineering margin, not proof all terminals are captured.
ingest_buffer.extension_rule: M3 must report disconnected cut edges and missing external connectors; increase buffer only through versioned parent review.

edge_policy.render_clip: pilot_scope; context may be shown only with licensed pack coverage
edge_policy.destination_support: Only independently verified routable entrances inside or on the pilot polygon are supported destinations.
edge_policy.outside_origin: Manual/GPS origin outside pilot receives outside-supported-area status; no silent clamp or invented route. Later reviewed connector support requires separate policy.
edge_policy.route_excursions: Ingest buffer does not authorize routing outside scope. Boundary-crossing paths require explicit later reviewed connector/access policy.
edge_policy.display: Show supported-region boundary and partial coverage label; unknown places/menus/paths stay unknown.

expansion.requires: New versioned project or authoritative coverage polygon, source rights, field/topology QA and parent review.

identity_contract: service_area_id and zone_id are immutable engineering scope references, distinct from canonical domain UUID entity IDs; M3 must record an explicit reviewed ref-to-UUID mapping before database import.
